html:
The best UGC creator platform for you depends on whether you want content or sales. UGC marketplaces like JoinBrands connect you with creators who produce videos you can use in ads, while TikTok Shop affiliate platforms like Euka and Reacher connect you with creators who sell your product for commission. They look similar and solve different problems. Here is the distinction and how to choose.

UGC content vs affiliate sales

  • UGC platforms / marketplaces (JoinBrands and similar): you commission creators to make content. You own the video and use it in your ads and listings. The deliverable is content, not sales.
  • TikTok Shop affiliate platforms (Reacher, Euka, Cruva): creators post to their own audience and earn commission on sales they drive. The deliverable is GMV.

Many brands buy the wrong one: a UGC marketplace when they wanted creators selling, or an affiliate tool when they just needed ad creative.

One reason UGC is so accessible: creators do not need a following to do it. As one put it, "you don't need followers for UGC. It is a good option to start... and you can get deals with very little" audience (r/UGCcreators). That is why marketplaces can field a deep bench of content creators, and also why UGC content and TikTok Shop selling are different jobs: one produces footage, the other needs creators with a buying audience.

When to use a UGC platform

  • You need a volume of content for your own ads and listings.
  • You want usage rights to the videos.
  • You are feeding a paid-ads engine that needs fresh creative.

UGC marketplaces are multi-platform and content-focused, so they are not TikTok-Shop-native the way affiliate tools are.

When to use an affiliate platform

  • You want creators posting to their own audiences and driving sales.
  • You care about GMV, not owning the footage.
  • You are building a TikTok Shop creator program.

The overlap

The two connect: UGC content can become ad creative, and affiliate creators produce content as a byproduct of selling. A mature program uses both, affiliate creators for GMV, UGC for a steady supply of ad-ready video. But start with the one that matches your primary goal.

How to choose

  • Need content for ads: a UGC marketplace.
  • Need creators selling on TikTok Shop: an affiliate platform, or a managed agency.
  • Need both, run for you: an agency that handles affiliate GMV and repurposes the content.

The takeaway

Decide whether your gap is content or sales, then pick the matching platform. UGC marketplaces make videos; affiliate platforms make GMV. Confusing the two wastes budget.

Want creators who sell, not just film? Book a call, or find TikTok Shop sellers in your niche.
